name: ds-stack
description: Data-science skills that make agent work trustworthy: check scripts and a fixed readout for analyses (ds-mode), launch calls made in code and one-screen readouts for A/B experiments (ds-experiment), and structure, format, concision and reader tests for documents (ds-doc, doc-tighten, cold-read).

interface.shortDescription: Trustworthy analyses and readable docs from agents.
interface.longDescription: Data-science skills that make agent work trustworthy: check scripts and a fixed readout for analyses (ds-mode), and structure, format, concision and reader tests for documents (ds-doc, doc-tighten, cold-read).
